scope: Real PostgreSQL production storage in a new schema; original synthetic inputs and injected SMTP transport

checks.name: Eight concurrent prepares commit one durable reply draft
Another owner and another mailbox cannot resolve or edit the source draft
Editing increments revision and stale confirmation stops before transport
Pool reconnect recovers the reviewed body, thread and source identity
Sending marker commits before transport and repeated confirmation calls it once
Saved receipt survives a second reconnect and reopening the trace
Unknown delivery remains durable and prevents another transport call
Original calendar and trace rows remain byte-equivalent JSON values
